div.div:
The strain sets
single-gene deletions with a label: morphology (Ohya 2005, CalMorph) 4,695; expression (Kemmeren 2014, Sameith 2015) 1,554; proteome (Messner 2023) 4,476.
with two labels: morphology and expression 1,439; morphology and proteome 4,281; all three 1,321.
genotype-only arms train on 3,757 strains; the expression-input arms on 1,161; the proteome-input arms on 3,464.
